# Frozen TypeScript parity corpus

`ts-final/http.json` is generated by `bun scripts/capture-parity-fixtures.ts`
against a disposable workspace containing a changed root repository, an
untracked file, and a nested Git repository. It records stable request,
status, content-type, and response-shape contracts from the frozen Bun/TypeScript
daemon. Volatile timestamps, process IDs, and temporary paths are normalized.

The Go daemon must add a focused parity test for each fixture before claiming
the corresponding endpoint is ported. Regenerate this corpus only when a
frozen TypeScript bug fix deliberately changes its public contract.

`ts-final/remote-pr.json` is generated by
`bun scripts/capture-remote-parity-fixtures.ts`. It creates a disposable bare
Git remote and a synthetic GitHub App device-flow/API response, then records
the successful remote PR queue, cached-worktree, open, status, and cleanup
lifecycle. Neither script contacts GitHub, Copilot, cmux, or a user cache.
